# Core talents (uniqueness / grants)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** talent, damage-pool

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Core talents modeled; 4 grant sources deduped by name; override flags; belt-blend equip. Mind Focus deferred.

## Implementation (engine model)

`core_talent_resolver.py::resolve_core_talents` runs collect → dedup → resolve. `_collect` gathers `(name, effects, tree_name)` from four sources in priority order — talent-tree `coreTalentSelections`, slate slots flagged `isCore`, legendary `granted_talents`, and equipped `belt_blend` (via `_build_catalog`). `Max Divinity Effect: 1` is enforced by deduping on the normalized name (`_normalize`, first wins → `seen` set). Each unique talent's effect strings go through `_resolve_talent`, which reuses the injected server resolvers `parse_mod`/`translate_cond`. `_classify_effect` sorts each line into: stat contribution (`{stat_key, amount, text '|core|<name>', condition_expr}`), `override` flag (`Changes the base effect of X` → `core_sacrifice`/`core_conductive`/`divine_grace`, applied in `aggregator.aggregate`), `set_value` (max_life/max_energy_shield), `automax_*`/`flag` (gain-on-hit blessings, `skill_no_mana_cost`), or `unresolved` (captured, never silently applied). Compound and shared-magnitude lines are split before classification; untranslatable conditionals are captured, not applied. NYI: Mind Focus (`Focus Blessing` re-base) is `deferred`.
